title: Runtime Product Readiness Map

authorityBoundary.repositoryAuthority: This artefact records bounded current-main runtime product readiness derived from USF semantic definitions, route/interface contracts, executable runtime proof, and validator-enforced source anchors.
authorityBoundary.runtimeProofAuthority: Executable runtime proof demonstrates bounded local in-memory and dev Compose behaviour only. It does not define semantics by itself and cannot upgrade unsupported proof rungs.
authorityBoundary.openapiAuthority: OpenAPI remains a lower-authority projection and cannot satisfy runtime proof on its own.
authorityBoundary.linearAuthority: Linear tracks work only and does not define USF semantic authority.
authorityBoundary.sourceCodeBoundary: Source code is used only when bound to semantic/interface contracts, runtime proof, and validator-enforced current-main anchors.

proofRung.rationale: Runtime readiness is bounded to local executable API and worker proof in dev-in-memory and dev-compose-backed modes against the canonical dev Compose target.

apiProofAssertions: canonical dev Compose target starts and waits before API proof
API binds to loopback on an ephemeral port
health route reports dev-compose-backed runtime mode
health route reports local-composed-real-service provider mode
readiness route reports service catalogue authority
readiness route reports active Postgres, Keycloak, Mailpit, MinIO, NATS, Temporal, and OpenBao provider bindings
tenant-context route publishes through NatsEventBus using the composed NATS SDK boundary
auth login route issues synthetic identity through KeycloakComposedIdentityProvider
file routes write and read synthetic objects through MinioObjectStore
permission route loads tenant membership through PostgresTenantMembershipRepository before synchronous PDP evaluation
tenant mismatch fails closed
authorization failure fails closed
tenant-context request captures audit evidence
notification API records providerMode composed-test and Mailpit providerRef without claiming API-side delivery
no deferred runtime provider binding is hidden behind dev-compose-backed mode
workerProofAssertions: canonical dev Compose target starts and waits before worker proof
worker run-once proof starts through the worker entry point
worker submits and executes a synthetic tenant maintenance job
worker cross-tenant job read fails closed
worker job lifecycle produces audit evidence
worker performs a PostgresTenantMembershipRepository SDK-backed write and readback
worker notification delivery uses MailpitNotificationProvider with SDK-backed readiness, write, readback, and cleanup
worker performs NATS publish/readback through NatsEventBus
worker performs MinIO object write/read/delete through MinioObjectStore
worker performs Keycloak synthetic identity readback through KeycloakComposedIdentityProvider
worker performs OpenBao secret write/describe/resolve/delete through OpenBaoSecretStore
worker performs Temporal workflow schedule/worker execution/result readback through TemporalComposedWorkflowEngine
all composed adapter proofs record readiness retry, metric, trace, audit, redaction, and cleanup evidence

bootHealthReadinessLiveness.livenessBoundary: process start, loopback bind, worker run-once completion, and teardown are proven locally; no external uptime/SLO claim is made

stateStorageMigrationBoundary.dataBoundary: Synthetic tenant, actor, file, job, notification, provider, and secret proof data only. No production data, migration execution, retention, backup supplier readiness, or live provider data portability is claimed.
stateStorageMigrationBoundary.migrationPosture: Local schema/runtime proof and provider-bound synthetic read/write evidence only; production migration, rollback, irreversible data-change safety, and live provider migration readiness are non-claims.
